purpose: Discover official ClinicalTrials.gov study-page candidates for NeuroAI-relevant interventional trials. Emit candidate source proposals only.
inclusion: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 search pages supplied by the caller
Optional post-retrieval interventional study-type filter with pre-filter denominator retained
exclusion: Hard-coded PRIMA or product-specific query logic
Live HTTP inside the discovery package

identity_key.name: nct_id
identity_key.match_rule: Exact NCT identifier. URL variants must not create a false NEW. Conflicting same-NCT normalized representations fail closed.

denominator_policy: Use API totalCount when countTotal was requested and pages report a consistent total. Cursor termination is not denominator reconciliation.
pagination_policy: Reject a non-final page without nextPageToken. fully_paginated means the supplied cursor walk terminated. It is not registry completeness.
known_identity_reconciliation: Optional NCT to source_id map. Exact NCT matches emit DUPLICATE regardless of URL query-string variants.
cadence: Human-gated. No automatic live poll in this package.
raw_input_boundary: Caller supplies already-retrieved search page payloads (fixture, OFFLINE_REPLAY, or separately authorized network capture). Discovery has no embedded live HTTP client.
human_review_path: execute_discovery_query proposals remain PENDING_HUMAN_ACCEPTANCE until adjudicate_candidate_source.

evaluation.precision_method: Sampled human review of NEW candidates (not executed by this software).

discovery_recall_anchors.notes: PRIMA NCT03333954 is an external recall anchor. It must not be hard-coded into query construction or inclusion logic.

boundary: SU-TRIAL is a discovery programme identity. SU-TRIALS is a documentation alias only. Programme execution emits candidates. It does not establish ClinicalTrials.gov completeness, NeuroAI trial recall, canonical source admission, or assessment effect.
